fusions.name: Final Sting
fusions.desc: A chop that deals 28 damage, leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and makes it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Felling Arc
fusions.desc: A full swing that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them back 2.5 tiles. It then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 50% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Split Hollow
fusions.desc: Splits open a hollow log that stands for 12 seconds; the nest inside stings an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Stinger Haft
fusions.desc: Conjures an axe edged with stingers. It increases your weapon damage by 12% and your attack speed by 4%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.
